title: Durable governed-effect lifecycle

scope: Independent provider-side receipt/status fixture with separate durable state
Ananke-owned durable execution intent and attempt state
Pre-dispatch durable intent and dispatch marker ordering
Scoped idempotency, bounded reconciliation, and secret-free audit projection
One normal Ananke governed consumer wired to the disposable receipt sink
Exhaustive Ananke effect-path inventory and central fail-closed durable-effect chokepoint
Deterministic owner-local tests and retained evidence
nonScope: All later runtime work beyond the bounded Ananke Batch 1 implementation, consumer wiring, and chokepoint enforcement batch
Moirae, Mnemosyne, or Runtime Contracts source changes
Live external effects, production credentials, and compatibility sealing
requirements: Independent provider receipt evidence remains separate from Ananke execution truth
Approval binding precedes durable intent, dispatch marker, provider call, and outcome/reconciliation
